'''Maia Miminoshvili''' ({{lang-ka|მაია მიმინოშვილი}}; born 1 August 1960), is a Georgian physicist and politician, [[Ministry of Education and Science of Georgia|Minister of Education and Science]] between 2007 and 2008 in the cabinet of [[Lado Gurgenidze]].

Born in Tbilisi, she got a degree in Mechanics and Maths for the [[Ivane Javakhishvili Tbilisi State University|Tbilisi State University]] in 1988.<ref>[http://www.nplg.gov.ge/bios/ka/00006800/ მაია მიმინოშვილი] {{in lang|ka}}</ref>

On 2008 was named director of the National Assessment & Examinations Center until 28 May 2012, when Minister [[Dimitri Shashkini]] fired her.<ref>[https://www.rferl.org/a/georgian-education-officials-firing-raises-charges-of-political-persecution/24597124.html Georgian Education Official's Dismissal Raises Charges Of Political Persecution]</ref> When [[Georgian Dream]] came to the power in the [[2012 Georgian parliamentary election|2012 parliamentary election]], Miminoshvili was renamed<ref>[https://www.finchannel.com/~finchannel/world/georgia/75586-two-deputy-education-ministers-senior-officials-dismissed Two Deputy Education Ministers, Senior Officials Dismissed]</ref> director of the NAEC until was dismissed again on 10 September 2018-<ref>[http://ajaratv.ge/mobile/index.php?m=news&id=33401&lang=en Education Minister Maia Miminoshvili and four more employees were dismissed]</ref> by Education Minister Mikheil Batiashvili.<ref>[http://www.mes.gov.ge/content.php?id=8644&lang=eng Mikheil Batiashvili has commenced systematic changes at the ministry]</ref>
